# Source: tzar_root_task_fkeymaster_properties.S and its .ld linker script.
# The adapter uses the verifier body made unreachable by the row above.
# Keep these two rows and the authentication bypass enabled/disabled together.
# ELF64 only: 112-byte records retain the original path. Only FKeyMaster's UUID,
# a 116-byte record, and a zero added word at 0x44 enter the conversion path.
# Samsung's S721B reader inserts that zero word when upgrading 112-byte records;
# this adapter performs the inverse: copy [0,0x44), then [0x48,0x74) to 0x44.
# Copies exactly 112 bytes after checking all 116 source bytes and overflow.
# Source ELF and downstream UUID/authority/rollback checks remain intact.
1|0x000088B4|C1C6FF54|E1990254|find_prop_in_mapped_ta_image|branch ELF64 non-112-byte properties to guarded FKeyMaster adapter
